# Unnat Classes

> Unnat Classes is a coaching institute in Faridabad, Haryana, India, offering
> tuition for Class 1 to 12 — all subjects for Class 1–10, a Humanities stream
> for Class 11–12, and a Competition Batch (GS Classes) for competitive exam
> aspirants. Founded and led by Tanuja Singh.

Website: https://www.unnatclasses.in
Phone: +91 9821602932
Address: A-7, Ganesh Nagar Colony, New Bhupani, Near Puri Aman Villa, Sector 89, Faridabad, Haryana, India

## Programs

- Class 1–5 (Foundation Years): all subjects, concept-based basics in reading, writing, and numeracy.
- Class 6–8 (Building Blocks): all subjects, strengthening core subjects and study habits.
- Class 9–10 (Exam Readiness): all subjects, board-exam preparation with full syllabus coverage.
- Class 11–12 (Humanities Stream): Political Science, History, Geography, Economics.
- Competition Batch (GS Classes): General Studies for competitive exam aspirants — History, Geography, Polity, Economics, Current Affairs.

## Founder

Tanuja Singh — Founder & Lead Teacher. 8+ years teaching Social Sciences, Liberal
Arts, Science, and Elementary Mathematics. CTET qualified and UGC NET
(Political Science) qualified. Holds a B.Ed, M.A. Political Science, M.A.
Public Administration, and B.A. Political Science (Hons.).
